cmd: echo '=== log file sizes/age ===' && ls -la /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== push failed after 3 attempts (main/sat/ai) ===' && grep -c 'push failed after 3 attempts' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== git-lock timeout occurrences ===' && grep -c 'lock не получен' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== rebase -X theirs не прошёл occurrences ===' && grep -c 'rebase -X theirs не прошёл' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== push attempt failures (individual retries, push X attempt N) ===' && grep -cE 'push .{0,3}(✗|attempt [23])' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== HEAD был detached occurrences ===' && grep -c 'detached' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>&1 && echo '=== sample of a push-failed block with context (main) ===' && grep -B5 'push failed after 3 attempts' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log 2>&1 | tail -60
